patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-bleed background images with text overlays and solid color backgrounds, creating distinct visual breaks.
A highly distinctive, custom-feel display typeface is used for the brand logo and hero headlines, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A vibrant, energetic royal blue dominates the site, used for the primary navigation, footer, and as a strong accent color throughout, paired with crisp white and dark grey for text.
The initial transparent header with a large logo transforms into a solid, compact blue sticky navigation bar with a smaller white logo and navigation links as the user scrolls down the page.
The hero section features a large, playful line-art illustration integrated with the headline, conveying a sense of fun and community.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay at the top of the page to a solid, reduced-height blue bar with a white logo and navigation items once the user scrolls past the initial hero content. This creates a clear visual distinction between the initial hero state and the persistent navigation.

Content sections are presented with a mix of full-width background images that have a subtle dark overlay for text contrast, and solid color blocks, providing visual rhythm and clear content segmentation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, custom display headings (~3-4x body) with a playful, rounded character, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — mostly sharp corners for layout blocks, but very subtle rounding on buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — generous vertical spacing between major sections, with a tighter grid for content cards and schedule listings.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, custom-feel typography used in the logo and hero headlines, which injects a strong personality and playfulness. This, combined with the dominant, energetic royal blue and the whimsical line-art illustration in the hero, creates a memorable and unique brand identity that feels less corporate and more community-focused than typical sports or fitness sites.
